verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page lists receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses, and the developer docs mention a receipts API surface, so the product has its own receipt-capture capability. Nothing documents how it works or how well. Missing for 10: email-forwarding capture, explicit OCR extraction details, automatic matching of receipts to the correct card transaction, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can snap a photo or forward an email and the platform OCRs the receipt and files it against the right transaction
